_about: Z13: zone mini-house object internals (furniture lists, placement, releasers, portals, effects, endurance, animations, emotions; wedding ring packets and married-state DB requests; pet player-side packets). Offsets are payload offsets. Layouts read in the 2016 zone code (house methods and InventoryLocking releasers) and checked against the 2016 client handlers; names from the 2017 PDB structs where they agree.
